name: SocialSelf (David Morin)
what_it_is: Social-skills publication + structured course for adults who feel awkward; quizzes and step-by-step training.
notes: Blog articles enumerate concrete exercises (conversation threading etc.); strong SEO competitor too.

name: Roger Love — The Perfect Voice / Voice of Influence
what_it_is: Celebrity vocal coach's speaking-voice programs: diaphragmatic breathing, middle voice, melody in speech; daily vocal exercises.
notes: Audio drill format; technique taxonomy (pitch, pace, melody, volume) well documented.

name: Udemy charisma/communication catalog (topic page)
what_it_is: Dozens of niche courses (charisma, banter, humor, small talk) with public curricula; quality varies.
notes: Course outlines are free to read — cheap curriculum mining across all domains.

name: SocialSelf — Conversation Confidence program
what_it_is: 10-minutes-a-day simulated-conversation training program to rewire conversation anxiety.
notes: Simulated-conversation drills + tiny daily dose = product-shape evidence; separate from SocialSelf blog entry.

name: Killer Stand-up (Steve Roye)
what_it_is: Online stand-up comedy system claiming to develop and deliver headliner-level material fast; structured modules.
notes: Old-school but systematic; marketing pages reveal method components.

name: Online Comedy Training
what_it_is: Self-paced stand-up writing progression system for beginners with step-up challenges.

name: Skillshare — Level Up Your Humor (Felipe Yanez)
what_it_is: Skillshare class on conversational comedy: humor styles, banter techniques, 30-day humor challenge.

name: The Power Moves — Power University
what_it_is: Lucio Buffalmano's text-based course on power dynamics, social skills, influence.
notes: Site also hosts detailed reviews of competitor courses — useful meta-source.
